decisions.label: Colours: party/forest (new) vs old
decisions.note: New (Ed, 2026-11-03: "the forest is cold, the party is warm"): your sigils, chains and runes pink, crimson, orange and gold by rank; the wild's lilac, purple, blue and turquoise; berries deep berry pink; the ley line ahead of its spark blue, purple and turquoise. Warnings stay pure red. Old: the colours before it (friends purple then three blues, the wild purple then three reds, cherry-red berries, the whole rainbow ahead). Reloads the night.
